features.title: Dark mode toggle for Jarvis
features.description: Add a dark/light mode toggle button to the jarvis.html header. Store preference in localStorage. Use CSS custom properties so a single data-theme attribute switches all colors. Default to dark.

features.title: Jarvis daily brief on open
features.description: When jarvis.html loads, automatically call GET /api/dashboard/summary and display a formatted morning brief as the first Jarvis message (no user input required). Show habits done today, tasks due today, and best streak. Only show if there is data — skip if no habits/tasks exist yet.

features.title: Streak milestone toasts
features.description: When POST /api/habits/:id/complete causes a streak to reach 7, 14, 30, 60, or 100 days, include a milestone field in the response. In jarvis.html and index.html, show a short-lived toast notification (e.g. 'On fire — 30 day streak!'). Use an absolutely-positioned div that fades out after 4 seconds.

features.title: Habit color dots in Jarvis tool cards
features.description: When Jarvis calls list_habits or add_habit, render a small colored dot (using the habit's color field) next to the habit name in the tool result card in jarvis.html. The color is already stored in the DB. Update the toolResult and toolDetail rendering in jarvis.html's script section.

features.title: Task due-date countdown in tool cards
features.description: In jarvis.html tool cards for list_tasks and add_task, show a human-readable due-date label next to tasks (e.g. 'due in 2 days', 'overdue 1 day', 'due today'). Compute client-side from the due_date field. Highlight overdue in red using CSS color variable --danger.

features.title: Conversation clear button
features.description: Add a 'Clear chat' button to the jarvis.html header that calls DELETE /api/chat/history (create this endpoint in src/routes/chat.js — it deletes all rows from the messages table) then resets the chat UI to the welcome screen. Confirm with a single window.confirm before clearing.

features.title: Habit completion streak in API response
features.description: Modify POST /api/habits/:id/complete in src/routes/habits.js to return the updated current_streak in its response body using the existing streak calculation in src/services/habitService.js. Also return a milestone field (7, 14, 30, 60, or 100) if the new streak hits one of those values, otherwise null.

features.title: Keyboard shortcut hint and command palette
features.description: In jarvis.html, add a '/' slash-command system: when user types '/' as the first character, show a small popup above the input with quick commands: /habits (list habits), /tasks (list tasks), /summary (daily brief), /clear (clear chat). Clicking a command fills the input. Use CSS position:absolute above the input area.

completed.title: Dashboard — habits, tasks, streaks summary
completed.description: Built /api/dashboard/summary endpoint, real dashboard tab with stat cards, habit list, best streak, due today, and due soon panels.

completed.title: Jarvis chat with Claude tool use
completed.description: Built full Jarvis chat interface at localhost:3000 with Claude tool-calling for habits, tasks, memory. Shows tool call cards visually.
